≻.justification: Emission is a directed forward morphism from source toward the receiver through the propagation channel.

≺.justification: Demodulation is the contravariant reverse transformation that descends from the received signal back toward source parameters.

⋈.justification: The chain composes emission, propagation, and reception into a single sequential morphism with asymmetric roles on each side.

⊙.justification: The carrier is itself and provides self-reference as the invariant medium that knows its own identity.

∈.justification: The selection opens one signal state into multiple arms because any one of several emission or reception pathways suffices.

∋.justification: The context reunites the carried alternatives by union into a single discriminated transmission state.

⊤.justification: The open gate affirmatively touches constructive truth when narrowband emission propagates globally across the observational system, matching the CL8NK organism reading for gate open and global granularity.

⊥.justification: The closed gate constructively refutes transmission when no discriminable signal reaches the observer.

⊞.justification: The high barrier to rearrangement and the continuously deformable trivial role hold both at once as a live contradiction without resolution.

⊡.justification: The record is a permanent append-only fixation that cannot be undone once written.
